title: One earns, eighty eat
odia:
ଅରଜେ ଜଣେ ଖାଆନ୍ତି ପଣେ
ତା’ ଘରଟି ଡୁବଇ ଦିନେ।
literal_meaning: One person earns and eighty eat; that household will sink one day.
meaning_odia: ଜଣକର ରୋଜଗାର ଉପରେ ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚର ଭାର ପଡ଼ିଲେ ଘରର ଆର୍ଥିକ ଅବସ୍ଥା ଭାଙ୍ଗିପଡ଼ିପାରେ। ଜଣେ ଓ ପଣେର ତୁଳନାରେ ସେହି ଅସମତୁଳନକୁ ବଡ଼ କରି ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The verse sets one earner against eighty eaters, then pictures the household sinking under the imbalance. This edition reads the large number as an emphatic contrast between income and the demands placed on it. The warning concerns an unsustainable burden, not a rule that every household member must earn money.
usage_example: A household keeps increasing its spending while relying on one unchanged income. During a budget discussion, someone might recall this saying to show why the arrangement cannot continue. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ପଣ is a counting unit of eighty; here ପଣେ contrasts with ଜଣେ, one person. The sound pairing reinforces the numerical mismatch. The sinking house is a figurative image of ruin, not a literal flood prediction or an exact household-size threshold.

odia_summary: ଜଣକର ଆୟରେ ପଣକର ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ଚଳିଲେ ଘର ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହୁଏ।
english_summary: A household cannot sustain demands that far exceed its income.
